part.text: Fixed in include/fmt/format.h:4133. The formatter was casting the negative value directly to unsigned, producing its two's-complement magnitude. Now it uses `detail::make_write_int_arg` to extract the sign and absolute value, so `fmt::group_digits(-12345)` correctly yields `-12,345`. All 20 tests pass.
